name: CryptoHack
summary: Free cryptography course with challenges that start with encoding and XOR and build up to RSA, elliptic curves, and attacks on real protocols.

name: OverTheWire
summary: Wargames played over SSH, starting with Bandit for Linux command line basics and moving on to binary exploitation in Narnia and Behemoth.

name: PortSwigger Web Security Academy
summary: Free web security course from the makers of Burp Suite, with a lab for each topic such as SQL injection, XSS, and access control.

name: pwn.college
summary: Arizona State University's free course with hands-on modules on Linux basics, reverse engineering, and binary exploitation.

name: CyLab Security Academy
summary: Carnegie Mellon's free cybersecurity learning platform, formerly picoCTF, with beginner challenges in the common CTF categories.

name: Hack The Box
summary: Vulnerable machines and challenges you attack in a lab over VPN, plus guided courses in HTB Academy.

name: TryHackMe
summary: Guided rooms for beginners that run in the browser, many with a machine you start and attack as you read.

name: OWASP Juice Shop
summary: An intentionally insecure web shop you run on your own computer to practice finding web bugs, with a built-in score board.

name: CTFtime
summary: Calendar of upcoming CTF events, with team rankings and links to write-ups from past events.
